get.description: Retrieve a page of CRM objects of a specified type. You can control the data returned by specifying which properties to include using the `properties` query parameter. This endpoint supports pagination and allows you to filter results based on archived status.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

post.description: Create a CRM object with the specified properties and return a copy of the object, including its ID. This endpoint allows you to create standard objects in your HubSpot account, providing documentation and examples for guidance.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Archive a batch of CRM objects by their IDs. This operation moves the specified objects to the recycling bin, effectively archiving them. Use this endpoint to manage large numbers of objects that need to be archived simultaneously.

Create a batch of CRM objects of a specified type in HubSpot. This endpoint allows you to create multiple objects in a single request, streamlining the process of populating your CRM with new data. Each object must include the necessary properties for creation.

Retrieve a batch of CRM objects by their internal IDs or unique property values. This endpoint is useful for fetching multiple objects at once, allowing you to specify whether to include archived objects in the response.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

post.description: Update a batch of CRM objects in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify multiple objects at once by providing their details in the request body. It's useful for making bulk updates to object properties efficiently.

Create or update a batch of CRM objects in HubSpot using unique property values. This endpoint allows you to efficiently manage multiple objects by either creating new entries or updating existing ones based on the specified properties.

Search CRM objects of a specified type using various filters and criteria. This endpoint allows you to query objects based on their properties and return results that match the specified search criteria. It is useful for retrieving specific subsets of data from your CRM system.

get.description: Read an object identified by `objectId`. By default, `objectId` refers to the internal object ID, but it can also be any unique property value specified by the `idProperty` query parameter. The response can be customized using the `properties` query parameter to include specific object properties.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

delete.description: Move an Object identified by `{objectId}` to the recycling bin. This operation allows you to archive a specific CRM object of a given type, identified by its unique ID.

patch.description: Perform a partial update of an Object identified by `{objectId}`. `{objectId}` refers to the internal object ID by default, or optionally any unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query param. Provided property values will be overwritten. Read-only and non-existent properties will be ignored. Properties values can be cleared by passing an empty string.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

post.description: Permanently delete a contact and all associated content to comply with GDPR regulations. You can use the optional 'idProperty' set to 'email' to identify the contact by email address. If the email address is not found, it will be added to a blocklist, preventing future use.

Merge two CRM objects of the same type in your HubSpot account. This operation combines the properties and associations of the specified objects into a single object, identified by the primary object ID. Use this endpoint to consolidate duplicate records or unify data under a single entity.

get.description: List all associations of an object by object type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations between objects, with a limit of 500 associations per call. It is useful for understanding relationships between different CRM objects.

parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.
